questions.question_text:
The equation $x^{2}+bx=0$ has solutions $x=0$ and $x=6$.
What is the value of $b$?

options.why: Copies the solution straight into $b$, forgetting that $x=6$ comes from $x-6=0$.

questions.solution_text:
$x^{2}+bx=0$
$x(x+b)=0$
The non-zero solution comes from $x+b=0$, so $x=-b$.
